label: Phase 011's terminal transport cannot reuse phase 010's conversation file: 010's record is schemaVersion/id/conversationId/botId/role/text/at/runId/by and 011's inbound is channel/messageId/replyToId/timestampUnixMs/conversation/sender/text/raw, so 010's reader would skip it; convert transport shapes to 010's record before append.

A channel approval records no grant scope, so the same item answered from the terminal and from chat produces two different records; delete the Out of Scope line at 011 spec.md:53 and pass --scope through bots answer, defaulting to once.

Four --json surfaces ship four shapes with no version field (001 activity, 002 routines, 010 chat transcript, 011 channel list) and phase 003 must parse three of them; add one shared envelope {schemaVersion, kind, items} in 001 and have 002, 010 and 011 cite it.

The actor has three names across the phases: by on the answer and on a conversation message, actor on the run record, sender on a channel inbound message; name the resolved actor by everywhere and make sender the transport-level chat id that resolves to by.

Two phases add fields to HonoredPosture without a schema version bump, so a reader cannot tell declared-none from written-before-the-field-existed; 007 should bump RunRecord.schemaVersion to 2 and accept 1 and 2, treating a missing apps on a version-1 record as null, and 008 adds secretsUsed under the same version.

Five phases (002, 005, 008, 010, 011) modify state-root.ts, a second merge hotspot beside definition.ts, and no plan names it; extend the Phase Transition Rule to name both modules and add the state-root.ts row to the five plans.
